title: No reservation
instructions: Bir çift rezervasyonsuz bir restorana geliyor. Bekleme süresine ve seçeneklere dikkat et.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Good evening. A table for two, please.

script.speaker: host
script.text: We're very busy tonight. There's a forty-minute wait for a table inside.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Forty minutes? That's a long time. Is there anything outside?

script.speaker: host
script.text: Yes, we have a table on the terrace now, but it's a bit cold this evening.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: We'll take it. Can we have some blankets?

script.speaker: host
script.text: Of course. And there are heaters outside too.

questions.prompt: How many people are in Mark's group?
How long is the wait for a table inside?
questions.feedback: İçeride masa için kırk dakika bekleme var.
questions.evidence: There's a forty-minute wait for a table inside.

questions.feedback: Battaniye istiyor; dışarıda ısıtıcılar da var.
